notes: 2018_01 is an image-only scan of the full agreement (not used).

Governing documents: the 2017-2021 UHPA-BOR agreement (Art. VI, Art. XII, Appendix T), EP 9.225 and AP 9.360. The OHR page is an undated HR summary (capture 2017-02-07); it supplies FMLA/HFLL details and says faculty family-leave eligibility is in the Unit 7 agreement.

No paid parental leave, childbirth benefit, modified duties or part-time option appears in any saved source. Pregnancy is treated as a temporary disability paid from accrued sick leave (c4), with the Appendix T three-week minimum (c5) and the State TDI obligation met through it (c6).

Saved sources cite documents not saved: Article VII, Leaves Without Pay (agreement navigation list; the likely home of unpaid medical leave after sick leave); AP A9.420 Leave without Pay for BOR Personnel; AP A9.380 Vacation and Sick Leave (R-08); AP 9.350 (R-07); AP 9.470 Leave Sharing (R-05); HRS 398 as printed in R-09 (only 398-1 and 398-3 saved); HRS 79-8; Title 14 personnel rules; A9.770 and A9.771 (state TDI plans for civil-service and excluded employees); 29 CFR 1604; BOR policy RP 9-210 (governing EP 9.225).

The OHR page restricts State family leave to sick leave in excess of the 15 days required under the State's self-insured TDB plan; the agreement lets faculty use accumulated sick leave for family leave with no such limit. The agreement governs faculty (source precedence; EP 9.225 also says the agreement prevails); recorded in c4's note.
Vacation (c7) is earned only by 11-month C, R, S, B and A faculty; 9-month faculty and I-classification faculty do not earn vacation, so it is recorded under its named group.

Calendar: semester calendar stated ('Spring semester's commencement'; sabbatical 'six (6) months (a semester)'); no semester length stated, so no component uses term units; calendar.kind = semester, and the term length follows R8's order.

Chain, birth parent: family leave 4 months (unpaid; c1) with FMLA 12 workweeks (c2) and HFLL 4 weeks (c3) concurrent from its start; accrued sick leave (c4) within the family leave; Appendix T three-week minimum (c5) concurrent with the sick leave; Hawaii TDI (c6, met by the employer's plan) concurrent with c5 from week 1.
Chain, non-birth parent: family leave 4 months (c1) with FMLA (c2) and HFLL (c3) concurrent from its start; accrued sick leave (c4) and, for 11-month C/R/S/B/A faculty only, vacation (c7) within it.
Tenure clock: both provisions (c9 non-crediting of leaves over 30 days; c10 lengthening on request, 7-year cap) apply to any leave or reason, so flagged general_purpose (U1).
